title: PhysxVehicleTireAPI
summary: Tire parameters of a PhysX vehicle, shareable between wheel attachments: among them the friction-vs-slip graph and the physxVehicleTire:frictionTable relationship to a PhysxVehicleTireFrictionTable prim. The walkers parse every prim that lists it. A wheel attachment uses the prim its physxVehicleWheelAttachment:tire relationship targets (exactly one target), or itself when it lists this API.
notes: Its columns are not described yet.
